  "concordance_definition": "The paper does not explicitly define concordance but discusses the failure of animal studies to predict human clinical outcomes, implying a lack of agreement.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Preclinical experiments were not rigorously designed.",
    "Animal models are frequently condemned as poor predictors.",
    "Initial physiological descriptions of animal models rarely encompass all salient features.",
    "Models are often inadequate for studying how a drug affects various aspects of disease.",
    "Existing TDP43-mutant mice may be useful for studying drugs' effects on certain disease mechanisms, but a drug's ability to extend survival would most probably be irrelevant to people.",
    "Failure to exclude animals whose deaths are unrelated to the disease being studied.",
    "Failing to split littermates between control and treatment groups.",
    "Not taking gender into account.",
    "Genes introduced to induce disease are often not inherited reliably.",
    "Inconsistent phenotype in breeding colonies."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "More than 80% of potential therapeutics fail when tested in people.",
    "About a dozen experimental treatments for ALS had been shown to ameliorate disease in an animal model; all but one failed in the clinic.",
    "ALS TDI has tested more than 100 potential drugs in a mouse model of ALS.",
    "Eight of these compounds ultimately failed in clinical trials, which together involved thousands of people.",
    "Almost 90% of the mice had an average lifespan of 134 days, give or take 10 days.",
    "Male SOD1 mice show symptoms as much as a week before females and die about a week earlier.",
    "A week is a 4% variability in survival.",
    "When first described in 2010, all TDP43-mutant mice died within 200 days.",
    "When ordering mice from a breeding colony, the mice lived for up to 400 days without showing signs of disease.",
    "Lithium can boost survival of SOD1 mice by 30 days.",
    "A small clinical trial showed that lithium also extended life in people with ALS.",
    "Three separate phase III clinical trials for lithium enrolled hundreds of patients with a total cost of well over US$100 million.",
    "The median survival time of untreated animals was 20 days shorter than that observed elsewhere.",
    "Highly variable animal models could require hundreds of animals per group.",
    "Homogeneous animal models require as many as ten animals per group.",
    "It takes about $30,000 and 6–9 months to characterize the toxicity of a molecule and assess whether enough reaches the relevant tissue and has a sufficient half life.",
    "Experiments to test whether a drug can extend an animal’s survival will cost about $100,000 per dose and take around 12 months.",
    "An investment of $330,000 is necessary just to determine whether a single drug has reasonable potential to treat disease in humans."
  ]
